name: dfam-check
title_zh: 打印前先查悬垂壁厚的 DfAM 体检器
tagline_zh: 切片前花 30 秒，让 STL 过一遍五工艺的 DfAM 规则。悬垂、壁厚、支撑、摆放方向一次说清。
tagline_en: Before slicing, run your mesh through 5-process DfAM rules. Overhangs, walls, supports, orientation — one pass.
desc_en: Measure mesh files against Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) rules and report printability findings per process (FDM, SLS, SLA/DLP, metal PBF, MJF). Use when the user asks whether a part is printable, wants overhang/wall-thickness/support analysis of an `.stl`, `.obj`, `.ply`, or `.3mf` mesh, wants a build-orientation recommendation, or wants DfAM redesign guidance before slicing with `$gco
why_zh: 不是泛泛的网格检查，而是按 FDM/SLS/SLA/金属 PBF/MJF 各自工艺阈值逐条判。
why_en: Not a generic mesh checker — it applies process-specific DfAM thresholds per technology and gives orientation advice grounded in.
limit_zh: 只认 .stl/.obj/.ply/.3mf 网格，不碰 STEP/B-rep；只出报告和建议，不自动改模型。
limit_en: Mesh formats only (.stl/.obj/.ply/.3mf); no STEP/B-rep. Reports findings, never auto-fixes or adds supports. Metal PBF powder-removal paths are left.
title_en: DfAM pre-flight check for overhangs & wall thickness
